title: Wanda-Guided Sparse Perturbations for Efficient Zeroth-Order Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.16317v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models through forward-only evaluations, but high-dimensional random perturbations can limit optimization efficiency. Sparse perturbations reduce the search dimension, making the selection of informative coordinates critical. We propose Wanda-Importance Sparsity-MeZO (WIS-MeZO), which uses Wanda weight--activation saliency to construct task-conditioned sparse perturbation masks while keeping the pretrained model dense. We analyze support quality through gradient energy capture and relate it to gradient estimation and convergence. Across 16 benchmarks with LLaMA and Qwen models ranging from 3B to 32B parameters, WIS-MeZO achieves higher aggregate scores than MeZO and reaches comparable validation losses in fewer optimization steps. translated_title: 基于Wanda引导的稀疏扰动实现高效零阶优化
translated_abstract: 零阶（ZO）优化通过仅前向评估实现了大型语言模型的内存高效微调，但高维随机扰动可能限制优化效率。稀疏扰动可以降低搜索维度，因此选择信息丰富的坐标至关重要。我们提出了Wanda-重要性稀疏MeZO（WIS-MeZO），该方法利用Wanda权重-激活显著性来构建任务条件的稀疏扰动掩码，同时保持预训练模型的密集性。我们通过梯度能量捕获来分析支撑集质量，并将其与梯度估计和收敛性联系起来。在涵盖参数量从3B到32B的LLaMA和Qwen模型的16个基准测试中，WIS-MeZO获得了比MeZO更高的总分，并在更少的优化步骤中达到了相当的验证损失。与随机扰动和基于幅值的稀疏扰动的比较进一步凸显了信息丰富的支撑集的重要性。
tldr: 提出WIS-MeZO方法，利用Wanda权重-激活显著性构建任务条件的稀疏扰动掩码，在保持模型密集的前提下显著提升零阶优化效率，在LLaMA和Qwen模型上超越了MeZO。
